candidate_sentence_map.S1: AB Amber Grid reported a significant improvement in financial performance for the three-month period ended 31 March 2026.
candidate_sentence_map.S2: Revenue increased by 58% to EUR 32,821 thousand, driven by higher transmitted gas volumes and transmission prices.
candidate_sentence_map.S3: Operating expenses decreased to EUR 9,570 thousand as natural gas costs fell.
candidate_sentence_map.S4: EBITDA reached EUR 23,304 thousand, operating profit was EUR 19,627 thousand, and net profit was EUR 15,763 thousand.
candidate_sentence_map.S5: Total assets stood at EUR 324,064 thousand, while total equity increased to EUR 182,039 thousand.

evaluation.label: Not generally
evaluation.justification: K1, K2, and K4 are PRESENT: S2 covers revenue growth drivers, S4 covers net profit and EBITDA figures, and S3 covers natural gas cost reduction. However, K3 (adjusted EBITDA details), K5 (borrowings reclassification and net debt), K6 (litigation with Alvora UAB), and K7 (post-reporting general meeting outcomes) are MISSING entirely. With only 3 out of 7 key information units adequately represented and all HIGH-importance items K3, K5, K6, K7 missing, coverage is insufficient to qualify as generally yes.
